title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges or portal users, to access item valuation rates of records they should not be authorized to view by sending crafted requests.
